course: CSC 307 Fundamentals of Data Mining and Warehousing, UBIDS
topic: 01 - A Basic and Senior High School Performance Data Warehouse
synthetic_statement: All records are synthetic. No real learner, teacher, school or examination result is represented.

dim_date.grain: One row per calendar day, 2020-09-01 to 2025-12-31.
business_rules: is_public_holiday: Moveable Christian and Muslim holidays are approximate
holiday_name: NULL when is_public_holiday is false
season: Single (unimodal) rainy season in the north

dim_location.grain: One row per town or community in the region's 11 districts (conformed dimension).
business_rules: urban_rural: District capitals are Urban, all other towns Rural (to confirm in field)
electoral_area: Placeholder until the real electoral-area list is collected

dim_school.grain: One row per school per version of its facilities; a new row is added when a tracked attribute changes.
business_rules: emis_code: Format UWnn-L-sss; stable across versions
school_level: Primary schools include attached KG1-KG2 classes
free_shs_category: Not applicable for Primary, JHS and private schools
effective_from: SCD2 housekeeping
effective_to: Versions of one emis_code never overlap
is_current: Exactly one current row per emis_code
learner_pseudo_id: Random token; never a real index or Ghana Card number
free_shs_beneficiary: Not applicable for JHS candidates
shs_programme: Not applicable for JHS candidates

dim_subject.grain: One row per examination subject per examination level.

dim_examination.grain: One row per examination type per year per sitting.
business_rules: sitting: BECE has a single sitting; school WASSCE is May/June

dim_teacher.grain: One row per subject teacher in an examination-sitting school (current snapshot).
business_rules: is_trained: Untrained = no Diploma/B.Ed/PGDE

fact_exam_result.grain: One row per candidate per subject per examination.
business_rules: school_key: Point-in-time join to dim_school
candidate_index_no: Prefix SYN- marks it as synthetic
raw_score: NULL only when is_absent is true
grade_point: NULL only when is_absent is true
is_passed: Pass threshold to confirm with WAEC/DEO in field

questions: Which districts have the widest gap between girls' and boys' BECE pass rates, and is it narrowing?
How does the pupil-trained-teacher ratio relate to WASSCE core-subject passes? (join fact_staffing on school and term 3 of the exam year)
Do trained subject teachers and schools with ICT labs get better Computing/STEM results?
measures: Pass rate = AVG(is_passed) over non-absent rows

fact_enrolment.grain: One row per school per class per academic term.
business_rules: avg_daily_attendance: Never exceeds enrolled_boys + enrolled_girls

questions: Do schools without electricity or girls' toilets show higher dropout among girls?
How do enrolment, attendance and dropout vary by district, term and season?
What is the gender parity index by level and district?
measures: Girls' dropout rate = SUM(dropouts_girls) / SUM(enrolled_girls + dropouts_girls)

fact_staffing.grain: One row per school per academic term.
business_rules: teacher_vacancies: Norms: Primary 35, JHS 25, SHS 25 pupils per teacher
total_enrolment: Must reconcile with fact_enrolment

questions: Which schools and districts have the highest pupil-trained-teacher ratios?
Where are teacher vacancies concentrated, and is the share of trained teachers rising?
measures: Share of trained teachers = trained / (trained + untrained)
